0x0007E2.en: 「T-this... is as far as I go...!」

0x000814.en: 「With my skills now...@ this is my limit...!」

0x00090D.en: 「Damn it!@ You won't get me next time!」

0x000987.en: 「So this is... as far as I go...?」

0x000A6E.en: 「Oh dear...@ how uncool of me, honestly!」

0x000B37.en: 「Tch! So this is as far as I go...!」

0x000B72.en: 「Like hell I'll screw up here...!@ This isn't fun...」

0x000BC6.en: 「I blew it...!@ Nothing to do but bail...」

0x000CB0.en: 「This is as far as I go...!」

0x000D17.en: 「This is it for me... the rest is yours.」

0x000DC3.en: 「No good, took too much damage... Retreating!」

0x000E10.en: 「Well, I'm beaten. I leave the rest to you.」

0x000E4E.en: 「Kyaah, I'll leave the rest to you!」

0x000E95.en: 「To think the Granzon... would be shot down...」

0x000F40.en: 「Ugh... So I'm the one falling like a star... Ejecting!」

0x000FBF.en: 「I-I can't take any more of this...!」

0x000FF7.en: 「Owowow... I give up, guess I miscalculated.」

0x001038.en: 「Well now, they went and got me!」

0x00107C.en: 「U... ngh! So this is as far as I go...!」

0x0010E9.en: 「Ugh! All hands, abandon ship at once!!」

0x001130.en: 「Sorry, the rest is up to you.」

0x001165.en: 「Damn it! Is this the limit of my power...!」

0x001251.en: 「To go down in a place like this...@ I'm still not ready...!」

0x00129F.en: 「No good, I can't take any more! Retreating!」

0x001389.en: 「N-no good! This is as far as I go!!」

0x0013C7.en: 「Well, well. This is the end, then.」

0x0013F6.en: 「I can't go on. Allow me to take my leave.」

0x001481.en: 「Was I careless...?@ I'll fall back for now...!」

0x0015E7.en: 「Bailing out...@ Ngh...! Not very graceful of me...」

0x001952.en: 「Hey, Yang Long.@ Prince Feil is Prince Terius's older brother and@ the first in line to the throne, right?」

0x0019E3.en: 「You're just as curious about him as you are@ about General Kirkus, aren't you?」

0x001A51.en: 「Ho... I thought you were just brash,@ but you're pretty sharp.」

0x001AAA.en: 「...Hey now, that's no way to talk@ to a lady!」

0x001B06.en: 「You should say lines like that@ once you've grown more ladylike.」

0x001B62.en: 「Sheesh, always with the mouth.@ So, did something happen with Prince Feil?」

0x001BFB.en: 「Oh, fine.@ So what kind of person is Prince Feil?」

0x001C54.en: 「He's not a bad man, but...@ at times his eyes take on a dark glint.@ That's what troubles me.」

0x001CDB.en: （I knew it, something must have happened...）

0x001D15.en: 「That's enough talk. Let's head to the briefing room.」

0x001DB8.en: 「That base originally belonged to Langran,@ so we have its structural data. We need to@ find out who these captured Earthlings are first.」

0x001E93.en: 「Right, if they turn out to be <Neue DC> remnants,@ there'd be no need to mount a rescue.」

0x001F2E.en: 「Ranshao and I will go. In Shutedonias army uniforms,@ using the "cloak," we can slip inside@ without the enemy noticing.」

0x001FD3.en: 「We'll also want one or two more skilled hands...」

0x002041.en: 「Right, Lune would be a good fit.」

0x00208E.en: 「I've got confidence in my reflexes and vision.@ I can stop a bullet cold with this wristband.」

0x002151.en: 「Yup, it's made of titanium wire and aramid fiber.@ What about you, will you be all right?」

0x0021D2.en: 「I'm trained in Northern Shaolin kung fu.」

0x002200.en: 「Then the internal recon is up to you two.@ If any Steel Dragon members are being held,@ attempt a rescue.」

0x00229C.en: 「On your signal, we'll begin@ the assault on the base.」

0x00231A.en: 「The problem is the lag between your signal@ and our arrival. If this ship gets too close@ beforehand, they may read our intentions.」

0x0023EF.en: 「We'll manage on our end.@ Just get there as fast as you can.」

0x002457.en: 「Then we'll head to the enemy base ahead of you.」

0x0024BF.en: 「Ahahaha! It suits you, Yang Long!@ From any angle you look exactly like@ a Shutedonias soldier!」

0x00255B.en: 「...This is no time to laugh. Put on your uniform too.」

0x00259E.en: 「No way, not in that getup.@ I move easier like this.」

0x002616.en: 「Fine, if I absolutely have to, I'll wear it.@ Anyway... I've got a bit more respect for you now.」

0x0026D0.en: 「I didn't think you'd help us out.@ Figured you'd run straight to General Kirkus@ the first chance you got...」

0x002784.en: 「I'd like nothing more, but right now the top priority@ is ending this war with the Shutedonias army.」

0x002810.en: 「Besides, after all the help you've given me,@ I can't just pretend not to care.」

0x002890.en: 「You're a better guy than I thought.」

0x002902.en: 「Master, the underground waterway on the@ south side wasn't sealed off.」

0x00295B.en: 「The enemy's also using the original surveillance@ gear, so with the "cloak" we can slip@ inside without trouble.」

0x002A0D.en: 「Any idea where they're holding the Earthlings?」

0x002A98.en: 「You were the one leaking the Earthlings' info...!?@ What are you playing at!?」

0x002B10.en: 「To cut down those the bait lures in.」

0x002B87.en: 「My real target is a man close to them.」

0x002BB2.en: 「You've got to be kidding.@ We're already scrambling with Feil's army@ closing in on the capital...!」

0x002C51.en: 「But this time I won't fail like before.@ I'll use every last one of them as hostages.」

0x002CD4.en: 「I'd prefer a fair, head-on fight, but...@ will Lieutenant Radius allow it?」

0x002D45.en: 「No Magic Mecha, and we can steamroll her.@ She's usually the quiet type anyway.@ I'll get the Earthlings out of their cells now.」

0x002E11.en: 「...The machines in that hangar,@ that's a Fairlion and a Grungust Type-3...!」

0x002E88.en: 「Never mind Bullet and Kusuha,@ even Princess Shine was summoned...」

0x002EF6.en: 「So it's certain your comrades have been captured?」

0x002F3C.en: 「There's a nasty Earthling named Murata,@ but once Bullet and the others are out of their cells,@ there's a chance to save them...!」

0x002FDB.en: 「But at that timing, I wonder if the@ Hiryu Kai will make it in time...」

0x00304C.en: 「Regardless, send the signal.@ We'll go on ahead to the cells.」

0x0030D7.en: 「Wait, someone's coming. You and Ranshao, hide.」

0x00316A.en: 「Moving carelessly draws suspicion.@ I'll stand here as a wall, so you two hurry and hide.」

0x00324E.en: 「The way to the hangar,@ i-is this the right direction...?」

0x0032B1.en: 「T-that is... I'm still not used to this place...」

0x0032F1.en: 「Turn there and go straight, and you'll reach the hangar.」

0x003350.en: （No mistake, she's the woman we fought in the Valley of Spores.@ She's so different from how she was in battle...）

0x0033C5.en: 「W-what!? We haven't been spotted, have we!?」

0x00340E.en: 「Something may have happened outside.@ Either way, let's hurry to the cells!」

0x003470.en: 「They attacked with just one machine!?@ The nerve of them!」

0x0034C0.en: 「Hehehe...@ At last we meet, Sanger Zonvolt.」

0x003513.en: 「Murata... So you came to this world too.」

0x003550.en: 「When I learned the Steel Dragons had been summoned,@ I had a hunch, and it proved right.」

0x0035C1.en: 「So you mean to swing your cruel blade in this world too.」

0x0035FE.en: 「If it can cut man and machine, the place matters not.@ Least of all when the foe is you, Sanger.」

0x003672.en: 「The Steel Dragons may come later...!@ In that case, we'll use the Earthlings as hostages...」

0x0036E9.en: 「You! Can you truly stoop so low!?」

0x003726.en: 「We cannot afford to lose this base, Lieutenant!@ Besides, I've already made all the arrangements!」

0x0037DA.en: 「Reprimand me later! I have no way back either!」

0x00381A.en: 「...If you don't value your lives, then come.@ All who stand before me, I cut down with the Zankantou.」

0x0038AC.en: 「We have hostages!@ Disarm at once! Otherwise...」

0x003959.en: 「I am Sanger! Sanger Zonvolt!@ The sword that cleaves evil!!」

0x0039BB.en: 「W-what!? Are you even listening!?@ You'll regret this!」

0x003A60.en: 「He's every bit what he claims...!@ Bring out the hostages, now!」

0x003AC5.en: 「W-what are you doing!?@ I never said to put them in a machine!」

0x003B2A.en: 「Your subordinates are out cold...@ er, unconscious, that is!」

0x003BE0.en: 「Major, you heard our transmission@　and came to help us!」

0x003C39.en: 「I-Impossible, an intruder got in...!@　And that man charging in alone was just@　to distract us and buy time...!?」

0x003D30.en: 「Princess Shine, leave this to us!@　Get Lune and the others to the Hiryu Kai!」

0x003E00.en: 「Ugh, this is just like last time!」

0x003E49.en: 「Brooklyn, Kusuha.@　Were you two the only ones captured?」

0x003EEC.en: 「Then all that's left is to whip these guys!@　Let's go, boys!」

0x003F4B.en: 「I've been waiting for this, Sanger!@　My blade trembles for a duel with you!」

0x003FC8.en: 「A blade of villainy can't cut me down, Murata!」

0x00400E.en: 「Rishu's disciple!@　I'll send you to hell ahead of your master!」

0x004064.en: 「I'll shatter your Shishioh Blade@ with my Type-3 Shishioh-blade!」

0x0040C0.en: 「You were quite different when you asked me for directions earlier.」

0x004109.en: 「You, from back then!? So you were in disguise!」

0x004149.en: 「Th-the Zankantou...@　Don't tell me you mean to cut this whole fortress with it!?」

0x0041B1.en: 「You needn't tell me twice! Here I come!!」

0x0041E8.en: 「Mmgh, the tide's against me...!@　I'll settle this score another day!」

0x00423E.en: 「Th-this is too much...! Fall back at once!」

0x0042BF.en: 「All enemy signatures in the combat zone have vanished.」

0x0042F6.en: 「We rescued Princess Shine and retook the base...@　An excellent outcome.」

0x00434F.en: 「Yes...@　With Major Sanger's help too, the luck was all on our side.」

0x0043C4.en: 「Everyone... you have my deepest thanks for saving me.」

0x00440A.en: 「Not at all. We're just glad you're safe,@　Princess Shine Hausen.」

0x0044A9.en: 「Actually, Lune...@　you infiltrated dressed like that?」

0x004524.en: 「With a black panther in tow, and nobody caught on?」

0x00455E.en: 「Yeah... you'd think that'd stick out like a sore thumb.」

0x00459B.en: 「Well, a certain someone had a flawless disguise.@　Wish you could've seen it.」

0x00460C.en: 「I was breaking out in a cold sweat, myself.」

0x004637.en: 「By the way, Princess Shine,@　how did you end up in La Gias?」

0x004693.en: 「I was cleaning out the Fairlion's cockpit@　in Riksent when I was suddenly pulled into this world...」

0x004713.en: 「After that, the princess was captured by the@　Shutedonias army, right when Brooklyn and I@　happened upon them...」

0x00479A.en: 「They took the princess hostage,@　so we had no choice but to surrender.」

0x0047F9.en: 「And then they forced you to cooperate with them?」

0x00483C.en: 「No... it seemed they meant to transfer@　the three of us somewhere else.」

0x0048C6.en: 「Yes.@　Maybe that's why. They questioned us,@　but they never got rough.」

0x004938.en: 「Funny, considering they meant to use us as hostages.@　Well, we managed to bust you out,@　so let's call it all's well that ends well.」

0x0049EC.en: 「...So, Major Sanger,@　where did you come to La Gias from?」

0x004A3C.en: 「I'd taken the retuned DyGenGuard out over@　the Pacific with Yuuki and Carla and the@　others to run a test...」

0x004AD5.en: 「And there we ran into three units that looked like@　a new Lion series, and engaged them.」

0x004B3A.en: 「Could those have been Chienne and the others...?」

0x004B74.en: 「They didn't look like Earth Federation@　or Neue DC machines... After that, we were@　suddenly wrapped in light and brought here.」
